name: Upscale with Model
description: Makes an image bigger with an upscale model (Real-ESRGAN and the like), which draws in detail a plain resize cannot. The size grows by the model's own factor, 2 or 4 times. Big images are done in tiles, so they fit in memory. To change the result's size, follow it with Resize or Upscale Image.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.label: Tile size
inputs.description: Pixels per side of the pieces a big image is cut in (they overlap and are blended). Smaller uses less memory and is slower; an image no bigger than a tile is done whole. Lower it if memory runs out.
